edition.en: Transcribed by Claude from a scan of the August 1931 printing of A Night in Florence (翡冷翠的一夜, Crescent Moon Book Co., first edition 1927) on Wikimedia Commons, and checked against the Wikisource text; first published in the Poetry supplement of the Morning Post (晨報副刊·詩鐫), 27 May 1926.
edition.zh: 据维基共享资源所藏《翡冷翠的一夜》（新月书店，初版 1927 年）1931 年 8 月三版扫描页，由 Claude 校录，并与维基文库本对校；初刊于 1926 年 5 月 27 日《晨报副刊·诗镌》。

basis.en: First published in 1926; the author died in 1931. Public domain by age: the author died before 1956 and the text was published before 1931.
basis.zh: 1926 年首次发表，作者卒于 1931 年。作者卒于 1956 年前、作品发表于 1931 年前，按年限属公有领域。

note.en: Ten lines about two lives crossing for a moment, like a cloud’s shadow on a wave, or two ships meeting on a dark sea. It is here because it treats a brief meeting as complete in itself, needing neither surprise nor gladness, and still worth its light. Notice the instruction in the last stanza: remembering is fine, forgetting better, and yet the last thing he names is the light.
note.zh: 十行诗，写两个生命短暂的交会，像云影投在波心，像黑夜海上相逢的两条船。收在这里，是因为它把一次短暂的相遇看作本身完整的东西，不必讶异，也无须欢喜，却仍然值得那一道光亮。留意最后一节的嘱咐：记得也好，最好忘掉，可他最后说出的，是光亮。

excerpt.orig: 你記得也好，最好你忘掉，在這交會時互放的光亮！
excerpt.en: You may remember, better still, forget the light we gave each other as we passed.
excerpt.zh: 你记得也好，最好你忘掉，在这交会时互放的光亮！

gloss.en: This poem was later sung by an old blind man in the last act of Bian Kungang (1928), a play Xu Zhimo wrote with Lu Xiaoman.
gloss.zh: 这首诗后来被用作徐志摩与陆小曼合写的剧本《卞昆冈》（1928）第五幕中老瞎子的唱词。

gloss.en: 波心: the middle of the water, an old poetic word, as in Jiang Kui’s ‘the heart of the waves rocks, the cold moon makes no sound’.
gloss.zh: 波心：水的中心，旧诗词常用，如姜夔《扬州慢》“波心荡、冷月无声”。

gloss.at: 你我相逢在黑夜的海上
gloss.en: The image recalls Longfellow’s ‘Ships that pass in the night, and speak each other in passing’, lines that became an English saying.
gloss.zh: 这一意象让人想起美国诗人朗费罗的诗句“夜里驶过的船，擦肩时互相致意”（Ships that pass in the night），这句诗在英语里已成了俗语。

note.en: Ten lines that treat a brief crossing of lives as complete in itself; elegant and well shaped, though its ideas are lighter than its music.
note.zh: 十行诗把一次短暂的交会当作完整的事；优雅匀称，只是意思比音乐轻。
